description: This file defines the client-side logic for the 'Sales Funnel' page in an ERPNext application, including page load initialization, the SalesFunnel class with methods for setup, data retrieval, and rendering various charts and visualizations.

classes.name: SalesFunnel
classes.description: Client-side class managing the sales funnel visualization, data fetching, and chart rendering for the sales funnel page.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SalesFunnel instance, sets up the page, and fetches initial data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures page fields, default options, and event bindings for user interactions.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches sales funnel data from server-side methods based on current options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the selected chart type based on current options.

methods.name: render_funnel
methods.description: Draws the sales funnel visualization on a canvas element.

methods.name: prepare_funnel
methods.description: Prepares dimensions and data for funnel rendering, including calculating segment heights.

methods.name: draw_triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle shape on the canvas for funnel segments.

methods.name: draw_legend
methods.description: Draws a legend item with a line, circle, and label for funnel segments.

methods.name: render_chart
methods.description: Creates a bar chart visualization for other chart types.
